one_month_reasoning: No PANW earnings fall in the window to 2026-11-05. Q1 FY27 ends 2026-10-31. Q1 FY26 was reported on 2025-11-19 (8-K Ex.99.1), and EDGAR shows no Q1 FY27 date filing as of 2026-10-05, so a report before Nov 5 would mean results within 5 days of quarter-end. I treat it as outside the window. If the date announcement lands inside the window, it carries no information. Other things in the window: peer and hyperscaler earnings season (read-through on security budgets; I have no verified dates, so no directional view), macro prints, and sentiment on the AI-security theme. The stock closed at $419.91 on 2026-10-06, off an intraday high of $432.33. That is +97.5% over a year ($212.58 a year earlier) and up from $330.65 on 2026-09-11 (Twelve Data). After a move that sharp, short-term reversal and momentum roughly offset, so I use a near-neutral centre: median $417 (-0.7%). Dispersion is lognormal sigma 14.5%/month, between 1Y realized vol of 47.4% (13.7%/month at /3.5) and 3M realized of 57.7% (16.5%/month), both computed from Twelve Data closes. P(close >= $419.91) = 48%.

fair_value.method: Blend of 65% P/E and 35% DCF, both valued at Oct-2027. P/E: 54x (11-peer calendar-weighted NTM median 51.6x, plus a ~5% premium) x consensus Oct-2027 NTM non-GAAP EPS $5.01 = $270.5. DCF: owner FCF (adj. FCF less SBC), constant 845.5M shares, cost of capital 9.2% (10y UST 5.27% + 0.94 beta x 4.20% implied ERP), terminal growth 3.5% = $176. Blend: 0.65 x 270.5 + 0.35 x 176.2 = $237, about 44% below the $419.91 close.

bear.story: The AI-security re-rating unwinds and PANW de-rates to about 47x Oct-2027 NTM EPS of $5.01, a bit below the 51.6x peer median. Triggers: reported growth slows toward organic (~14% revenue in Q3 FY26) once CyberArk laps in Feb-2027, an NGS ARR shortfall against the +22-23% FY27 guide, a smaller LLM-migration tail at Chronosphere after Q1 FY27, or a broad high-multiple software sell-off. The $235 bear is the median of a lognormal with sigma 0.31, so the bear case also covers prices well under $200.

base.story: PANW meets or modestly beats guidance (FY27 revenue $14.10-14.20B, EPS $4.16-4.19), and consensus Oct-2027 NTM EPS of ~$5.01 holds. The multiple compresses from 97x to ~74x as reported growth converges to organic. That is still well above peers because the AI-security theme and momentum persist through the year. Component median $370, sigma 0.27.

bull.story: NGS ARR runs ahead of the $20B FY30 path, and the FY28 guide (Aug/Sep 2027) shows ~20% organic growth and the 40% FCF margin. Estimates rise to ~$5.30 NTM and the sector keeps CRWD/NET-like multiples, so PANW holds ~100x+. Component median $545, sigma 0.31.

comps_summary.peer_range: NTM P/E 11.9x (CHKP) to 224.5x (NET) across 11 peers; interquartile 24.1x (QLYS) to 62.2x (S); median 51.6x (OKTA), with FTNT 51.7x and SAIL 52.7x next to it. One basis for all: calendar-weighted NTM (Oct-2026 to Sep-2027) consensus adjusted EPS from each StockAnalysis forecast page (EPS this year / next year), weighted by the share of each company's current fiscal year left after 2026-10-06, priced at 2026-10-06 closes. PANW on the same basis is 97.3x. Forward EV/EBITDA is null for every peer: no consistent forward EBITDA was available from the sources I can verify. The round-1 TTM GAAP EV/EBITDA figures were mislabelled as forward and are distorted by SBC, so they were removed. No EV/EBITDA method is used. Peer next-FY EPS growth median +11.44% (PANW FY28 +16.48%); this-FY median +24.71% (PANW FY27 +9.09%).
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: 54x applied to Oct-2027 NTM EPS: ~5% above the 51.6x median and inside the interquartile range (below S 62.2x, CRWD 186x, NET 224x; above ZS 42.1x). PANW trades at 97.3x today, +89% over the median.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: Only a small premium is evidenced as persistent through the horizon. For: FY28 consensus EPS growth (+16.48%) and revenue growth (+14.49%) sit above the peer next-FY medians, and both fall inside the horizon. Scale (FY26 revenue $11.48B; RPO $21.2B, +34%) and a 38% FY27 / 40% FY28 adj. FCF margin are guided and structural. Against: FY27 EPS growth is only +9.09% because of the 112M-share CyberArk issuance and SBC of ~14-15% of revenue, against a peer this-FY median of +24.71%. Organic revenue growth (+14.2% in Q3 FY26) is mid-pack. Netting these gives ~5% (54x). No sell-side outperformance argument is used. Peers dropped from round 1: DDOG (observability, not security), CSCO (networking conglomerate), RBRK (loss-making, P/E not meaningful). Added: SAIL (identity, competes with CyberArk) and FFIV (application/network security, hardware mix). RPD was considered and excluded because consensus revenue is shrinking (-2.40% this year, -1.07% next), so it is not a similar-growth peer.

thesis_break_reason: $225 is the 51.6x peer-median multiple on zero EPS growth over the next year: 51.6 x today's NTM EPS of $4.32 = $223. It is also ~45x consensus Oct-2027 NTM EPS of $5.01, and below the 2026-05-27 intraday low of $243.04 (Twelve Data; citation gate: not the late-May trough, which was $235.26 on 2026-05-20, and the stock traded below $225 as late as 2026-05-12). Trading there would most likely mean estimates are being cut, not just that the AI premium is fading: an NGS ARR guide cut below +22%, the 40% FY28 FCF target withdrawn, CyberArk/identity slippage, or a hardware-margin squeeze. Moves to $250-330 fit multiple normalisation alone, which is my central thesis.

key_uncertainties: Whether the 97x NTM multiple persists. The stock is up 97.5% in a year while FY27 EPS is guided up ~9%; peers CRWD and NET trade at 186-225x NTM, and that sector premium could last or unwind together.
Organic growth after CyberArk laps in Feb-2027: Q3 FY26 organic revenue was +14.2% and organic NGS ARR +28%. The FY27 revenue guide (+23-24%) is partly inorganic.
FY29+ EPS path: no FY29 consensus is published free, so FY29 uses the 14.4% 3Y CAGR (estimate).
Discount rate: with the 10y at 5.27%, the DCF is sensitive. Each ±0.5pt of cost of capital moves it by about ±$12-17/share.

reasoning: Round 2. I rechecked the supervisor's figures at primary sources. The Q4 FY26 8-K confirms FY27 revenue $14.10-14.20B, NGS ARR $11.075-11.175B, EPS $4.16-4.19, op margin 29.5% and adj. FCF 38%, plus the 40% FY28 and $20B FY30 targets. It also confirms the balance-sheet items behind $6.132B net cash, SBC $1,712M and 832M Q4 diluted shares. The Q3 8-K confirms $388M of acquired revenue on $3,002M vs $2,289M (organic +14.2%) and $1.6B acquired NGS ARR; the 10-K cover confirms 818M shares. StockAnalysis confirms FY28 consensus EPS $4.88 (+16.48%) and FY28 revenue +14.49%. My round-1 FY28 path (+18% revenue, $5.02 EPS) was above consensus. I now use consensus: Oct-2027 NTM EPS $5.01. Peer set rebuilt to 11 security names on one calendar-weighted NTM basis, using each peer's own this-FY and next-FY consensus. Here I disagree with two supervisor estimates: it derived FTNT FY27 as $4.00 and CHKP FY27 as $10.63 from 3Y CAGRs, but the published consensus is $3.78 and $11.29. My median is therefore 51.6x, not 49.5x. Premium is cut from 65x to 54x because PANW's NTM-window growth is about median. P/E method: $270.5. DCF: I removed the double count (SBC deducted, shares flat at 845.5M). I replaced my unsourced 8.5% WACC with CAPM on verified inputs (10y 5.27% Treasury, beta 0.94, Damodaran implied ERP 4.20%, giving 9.22%) and cut terminal growth to 3.5%: $176. Blended fair value is $237 (65/35). The supervisor's $284 does not deduct SBC (it says so itself), which is the main gap. For the 12-month distribution I do not assume the valuation gap closes within a year. The sector re-rating is broad, momentum is strong and the consensus target is $396. So the ladder is a three-scenario lognormal mixture: bear $235 (30%, sigma 0.31), base $370 (45%, sigma 0.27), bull $545 (25%, sigma 0.31). Ladder median $358, mean ~$390, mixture log-sd 0.43 (between 1Y realized 47.4% and a more mean-reverting view); P(>= $420) = 35%. Scenario-weighted price is $373. The ladder sits ~$120 above fair value because a full de-rating to peer multiples within 12 months is a minority outcome (P(< $252) ~21%). Lane note: 11 of the 32 sources are peer EPS pages required by the comps rule. Excluding those, 16 of 21 sources are primary filings or company documents.
